issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: three RefsLibraryTests scan tests fail after the scan-receipt observer landed

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
bob-mac-capture macOS CI fails on two consecutive SHAs, 1c35b30 (run 40022204228) and
6e1f84c (run 40022625780). On both, all 2922 tests run and the same three fail:

```
RefsLibraryTests.swift:614 testFinishedAfterPostScanListWithNewRows: expected scan and post-scan list in record
RefsLibraryTests.swift:543 testScanRunsOneScanArgv: XCTAssertEqual failed: ("0") is not equal to ("1")
RefsLibraryTests.swift:573 testSecondScanMidFlightReturnsFalse: XCTAssertEqual failed: ("0") is not equal to ("1")
```

The last green run is 9fb67f3 (40011724496: 2908 tests, 0 failures). 6dc2c12 "feat(refs):
observe scan receipts and notify for open PDF updates" (bob-cli-at.6) first failed to compile
(40015370455, RefsScanReceiptObserver.swift); 1c35b30 and 6e1f84c fixed compilation. The scan
path now records no `ref scan` argv in the fake-bob record, so the scan receipt observer
change plausibly altered how RefsLibrary invokes or records the scan. That is a lead, not a
verified root cause. Same failures on two SHAs, so this is not a flake. Run 40022204228 also
had one `RefsRankingTests.testPerformanceGuard` overrun (10.13 s vs 10.0 s), which did not
recur on 6e1f84c; treat that one as a separate possible flake.

payload.entry: Verified by lander bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5 (2026-10-24). bob-mac-capture 6d41b2e updates RefsLibraryTests to the attended scan argv 'ref scan -a -w -f json' that the scan-receipt observer work introduced. Root cause: the expectation was stale; the scan was never missing. macOS CI run 40095658827 on 6d41b2e executes 2938 tests; testScanRunsOneScanArgv, testSecondScanMidFlightReturnsFalse, and testFinishedAfterPostScanListWithNewRows are no longer among the failures (they failed on 54131b1 run 40090432753). The run's only failures are three CapturePanelModelTests submit-argv assertions that also failed on 54131b1 and predate this fix. They had no owner, so the lander filed them as bob-cli-be (ci, linked related to b7). Assertions were tightened to the real argv, not weakened.
